sentences.text: Haemophilus influenzae has served as a model organism in numerous ways over the last century and is famously associated with both asymptomatic colonization and a variety of disease states.
Nontypeable strains are commensals isolated from the upper and lower respiratory tract and are described as a predominant organism of the nasopharyngeal microbiota.
The organism depends nutritionally on haem and iron at every stage of infection, a dependency proposed as a therapeutic target.
A systematic review and meta-analysis reassessed age-specific nasopharyngeal and oropharyngeal carriage in childhood before and after Hib vaccination.
Reported disease associations include sinusitis, acute otitis media in preschool children, and exacerbations of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
